popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Book VIII tells the purple lock — Scylla shears her father's life from his head for Minos, then becomes the ciris bird as he sails away.

popCulture.title: Ciris
popCulture.description: The pseudo-Virgilian epyllion retells the Megarian betrayal — Nisus' lock, Minos' siege, and the girl's metamorphosis.

popCulture.title: Scylla of Megara
popCulture.description: The princess who traded a city for love remains the name for filial betrayal sealed by a single purple hair.
